name: RFP evaluation
goal: Score every vendor the same way and reach a decision in a week, not a month.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I can help you evaluate the vendor submissions. Ask me about the scoring, price or the rules we follow.

answers.reply: Each criterion has the weighting you set in the RFP. Scores are out of 5, multiplied by the weighting and added up, so the total is out of 100.
Prices are compared excluding GST over the whole term. If a vendor priced differently, the check converts it and notes that it did.
Everyone on the panel must declare any conflict of interest before scoring starts. If someone has one, they step out of the evaluation.
Submissions that arrive after the closing time aren't evaluated, unless the procurement manager approves an exception in writing.
Unsuccessful vendors can ask for a debrief. We tell them how they scored against each criterion, but never another vendor's price.

assistant.fallback: In the real app I'd answer that from the procurement policy. For now, try asking about weighting, price, conflicts of interest or late submissions.

steps.label: About the RFP
steps.goal: Tell us what you're buying and how you'll judge it, so every vendor is scored the same way.

fields.label: Budget ($)
fields.hint: Over the whole term, excluding GST

fields.label: Has every panel member made a conflict declaration?
Criteria and weightings
fields.hint: One per line, with its weighting. They should add up to 100%.

sample.RFP title: Managed IT support for head office and 12 branches
sample.Criteria and weightings:
Price: 30%
Service levels and response times: 25%
Experience with similar organisations: 20%
Transition plan: 15%
Security and certifications: 10%

steps.label: Vendor submissions
steps.goal: Add every vendor's submission. Each one is checked as you add it, so gaps show up before scoring starts.

checklist.name: Vendor responses
checklist.check: One per vendor, answering every mandatory section
checklist.sample: One vendor skipped the transition plan section

checklist.name: Pricing schedules
checklist.check: In our template, excluding GST, covering the whole term
checklist.sample: One vendor's prices include GST and only cover the first year

checklist.name: Certificates of insurance
checklist.check: Current, with the cover the RFP asks for
checklist.sample: One vendor's professional indemnity is $2 million; the RFP asks for $5 million

checklist.name: Referees
checklist.check: Two from the last 3 years, from organisations of a similar size
checklist.sample: Both of one vendor's referees are from 2021

checklist.name: Conflict of interest declarations
checklist.check: Signed by everyone on the evaluation panel
checklist.sample: Two of the four panel members haven't signed

steps.label: Scoring
steps.goal: Here's each vendor scored against the criteria, with the evidence for every score and a recommended vendor.

steps.label: Decision
steps.goal: The decision makers see the scores and the reasons side by side, and approve the recommended vendor.

config.confirmText: The panel will look at the scoring again using your note. Say which scores or reasons you don't agree with.
